rows.grounds: numeral component forming the count eighty-four thousand
locative indicating the multitude in which torment occurs
compound denoting the loci or mechanisms of birth
describes beings subjected to suffering in those loci

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
These thousands are identified as womb-diagrams.
Beings in these womb-diagrams are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are subject to torment throughout the vast multiplicity of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is not explicitly named in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
